security: Bearer with documents:read, exact project/database authorization retained

parameters.after_collection: Optional with after_id; collection name from last delivered export line
parameters.after_id: Optional with after_collection; stored key, 1..256 UTF-16 code units without char.IsControl; opaque, never normalized

ordering: collection then id; resume strictly after last delivered line in a new snapshot
errors: 400 malformed cursor, 401/403 authorization, 404 unknown_database, 503 unavailable; incomplete stream is not completion
retry: No automatic restart or replay; caller resumes explicitly from last whole line
scope: Cursor validation only. Document point-operation inputs remain canonical uppercase ULIDs. No new operation or generated-contract completeness claim.
